title: PIMCO策略师：债券市场如何约束高负债主体？
speaker: Tony Crescenzi

segments.en: And raising borrowing costs, as you're seeing in the financial markets, can hurt some companies. Now it's great for bond investors.
segments.zh: 提高借贷成本，正如你在金融市场看到的，可能会伤害一些公司。现在这对债券投资者来说很棒。

segments.en: It's fantastic that the rising bond deals is occurring. It's a really great time to be in bond investors, because it's a global borrowing binge that letting bond investors sort of set the terms for certain bonds, if they're idiosyncratic or structural bonds.
segments.zh: 债券交易上升是好事。现在是债券投资者的好时机，因为全球借贷热潮让债券投资者能为某些债券设定条款，如果它们是特殊或结构性债券。

segments.en: But it's just a good time right now, in that sense, from the bond investors perspective.
segments.zh: 但从债券投资者的角度来看，现在就是好时机。

segments.en: We've been through this crazy week where there was so much attention on core weave and how much it's having to borrow to build out all of the AI infrastructure right on those core
segments.zh: 我们经历了疯狂的一周，CoreWeave备受关注，它需要借多少钱来建设所有AI基础设施。

segments.en: of junk bonds, hitting 15%. What does that tell you? How interested are you in that company? What does it tell you?
segments.zh: 垃圾债收益率达到15%。这告诉你什么？你对那家公司有多感兴趣？它说明了什么？

segments.en: What's the emblematic of when you look at the market in the AI universe more broadly? Well, it's not considered to be amongst the strong, as it's not a hyper scale or so to speak.
segments.zh: 更广泛地看AI领域的市场，这象征什么？嗯，它不被视为最强的那一类，因为它不是超大规模企业。

segments.en: But what it's showing you is that the bond market is willing to impose discipline on lenders that may have cash flow that's less clear to them, that's aesthetically put.
segments.zh: 但它向你展示的是，债券市场愿意对现金流可能不太清晰的借款方施加纪律，这是委婉的说法。

segments.en: So it may not apply to simply lower rated companies, it can eventually apply to high rated nations.
segments.zh: 所以这可能不仅适用于评级较低的公司，最终也可能适用于评级较高的国家。

segments.en: Look at the nation of France, considered much better as a credit, but it has a very high budget deficit, and the bond market is beginning to impose discipline upon that nation.
segments.zh: 看看法国，其信用被认为好得多，但预算赤字非常高，债券市场开始对该国施加纪律。

segments.en: It did so as well in 2022 with Liz Truss, the prime minister, she attempted to raise the budget debt, budget deficit, which would have meant more bond borrowing.
segments.zh: 2022年利兹·特拉斯首相时期也是如此，她试图提高预算赤字，这意味着更多债券借贷。

segments.en: The bond deal there, the 10-year yield rose 150 basis points in a few weeks, which is dramatic for a government bond market.
segments.zh: 那里的债券市场，10年期收益率在几周内上升150个基点，这对政府债券市场来说非常剧烈。

segments.en: So the core-wave story can be applied to all borrowers, even those with the high credit ratings. If the bond investor believes that the cash flow story is a little bit questionable, or at least not clear, and that's what's happening.
segments.zh: 所以CoreWeave的故事可以适用于所有借款方，甚至高信用评级者。如果债券投资者认为现金流故事有点可疑，或至少不清晰，这就是正在发生的事。
